cards.definition: An official section of a company with its own area of work.
cards.example:
- The legal department reviews every contract before we sign it.
O departamento jurídico revisa cada contrato antes de assinarmos.
- I moved to the marketing department last year.
Fui para o departamento de marketing no ano passado.
- Which department handles supplier payments?
Qual departamento cuida dos pagamentos a fornecedores?
cards.note: Abreviação comum em e-mails e organogramas: dept. Colocações: the finance department, the HR department, the IT department. Use in para dizer onde você trabalha: I work in the legal department.

cards.definition: All the people who work for a company or in one part of it.
cards.example:
- Our staff grew from twenty to sixty people in two years.
Nossa equipe cresceu de vinte para sessenta pessoas em dois anos.
- The staff were told about the change on Monday.
A equipe foi avisada da mudança na segunda.
- We have a staff of sixty in two offices.
Temos um quadro de sessenta pessoas em dois escritórios.
cards.note: É incontável: “staffs” não existe. O verbo costuma vir no plural, porque a palavra pensa nas pessoas: the staff are ready. Para falar de uma pessoa só, diga a staff member ou an employee.

cards.definition: The person who leads one area or department of a company.
cards.example:
- She is the head of operations for Latin America.
Ela é a head de operações para a América Latina.
- They promoted him to head of customer support.
Promoveram ele a head de suporte ao cliente.
- The head of finance signs every contract over ten thousand.
O head de finanças assina todo contrato acima de dez mil.
cards.note: A expressão exige o of: head of sales, head of people. Depois do verbo to be o artigo é opcional: she is head of sales. Acima costuma vir director ou VP; abaixo, team lead.

cards.definition: A fixed period of hours that one group of workers does before another group starts.
cards.example:
- The support team works in three shifts, including nights.
O time de suporte trabalha em três turnos, incluindo a noite.
- She worked the night shift for six months.
Ela trabalhou no turno da noite por seis meses.
- The company shifted its priorities after the merger.
A empresa mudou suas prioridades depois da fusão.
cards.note: Colocações: the morning shift, the night shift, work in shifts. Como verbo, shift é mudar de posição ou de foco: shift priorities. Passado: shifted.

cards.definition: Done by your own employees instead of by an outside company.
cards.example:
- We have an in-house design team instead of an agency.
Temos um time de design interno em vez de uma agência.
- We moved the translations in-house to save money.
Trouxemos as traduções para dentro de casa para economizar.
- All in-house training happens on Friday afternoons.
Todo o treinamento interno acontece nas sextas à tarde.
cards.note: Antes do substantivo vai com hífen: an in-house lawyer. Depois do verbo funciona como advérbio: we do it in-house. O contrário é outsourced ou done by an agency.

cards.definition: The rate at which employees leave a company and new ones arrive.
cards.example:
- High turnover in that department costs us three months of training.
A alta rotatividade naquele departamento custa três meses de treinamento.
- Turnover dropped after we changed the manager.
A rotatividade caiu depois que trocamos o gerente.
- British reports sometimes use turnover to mean total sales.
Relatórios britânicos às vezes usam turnover no sentido de faturamento.
cards.note: No RH significa rotatividade de pessoal; no financeiro britânico, faturamento — o contexto decide. É incontável. Colocações: high turnover, low turnover, staff turnover.

cards.translation: trabalhar em conjunto / lado a lado com
cards.definition: To cooperate with someone very often and in detail.
cards.example:
- I work closely with the finance team on every quarterly report.
Trabalho lado a lado com o financeiro em todo relatório trimestral.
- I worked closely with the legal team on the new contract.
Trabalhei lado a lado com o jurídico no contrato novo.
- Designers work closely with developers in every sprint.
Os designers trabalham em conjunto com os desenvolvedores em cada sprint.
cards.note: Mostra proximidade real e diz muito mais que work with. A preposição é sempre with, nunca to. É a frase certa para explicar sua rotina numa entrevista ou numa reunião de apresentação.

cards.definition: Agreeing about a plan because everyone has the same information.
cards.example:
- Let's have a quick call to make sure we are all on the same page.
Vamos fazer uma reunião rápida para garantir que estamos todos alinhados.
- After the call, we were finally on the same page about the deadline.
Depois da call, finalmente ficamos alinhados sobre o prazo.
- I want to get everyone on the same page before we talk to the client.
Quero alinhar todo mundo antes de falarmos com o cliente.
cards.note: Os verbos mais frequentes são be on the same page e get on the same page. É informal, mas circula em qualquer reunião de trabalho. Não existe plural: nunca on the same pages.

cards.definition: An unfair opinion about a person or group formed before you know them.
cards.example:
- We have training about prejudice and bias in hiring.
Temos treinamento sobre preconceito e viés na contratação.
- The new hiring process was designed to reduce prejudice.
O novo processo de contratação foi feito para reduzir o preconceito.
- He spoke openly about the prejudice he faced at work.
Ele falou abertamente sobre o preconceito que enfrentou no trabalho.
cards.note: Não é “prejuízo”: perda financeira é a loss, e prejudicar é to harm ou to damage. Normalmente é incontável e vem com against: prejudice against a group. O adjetivo é prejudiced.

cards.definition: An official rule or plan that a company follows.
cards.example:
- Our remote work policy allows two days at home.
Nossa política de trabalho remoto permite dois dias em casa.
- Every new employee reads the security policy on day one.
Todo funcionário novo lê a política de segurança no primeiro dia.
- They updated the expenses policy in January.
Eles atualizaram a política de despesas em janeiro.
cards.note: Não é “polícia”: isso é the police. Plural: policies. Colocações úteis: privacy policy, expenses policy, it is our policy to answer within 24 hours.

questions.prompt: Which word means an official section of a company, such as finance or IT?
questions.explanation: A “department” is a permanent section of a company with its own work.

questions.prompt: We reduced _____ by twenty percent after the new benefits package.
questions.explanation: “Turnover” is the rate at which people leave a company.

questions.prompt: Quem é o head de tecnologia agora?
questions.answer: Who is the head of technology now?|Who is head of technology now?
questions.explanation: “Head of” is always followed by the area, never by the person's name.

questions.prompt: Which word covers everyone who works at the company, from interns to directors?
questions.explanation: “Staff” means all the employees, and the plural form “staffs” does not exist.

questions.prompt: Everything is produced _____ by our own team of six people.
questions.explanation: “In-house” means done inside the company, not by an agency.

questions.prompt: Nós trabalhamos lado a lado com os fornecedores todos os dias.
questions.answer: We work closely with our suppliers every day.|We work closely with the suppliers every day.
questions.explanation: “Work closely with” shows real, daily cooperation.

questions.prompt: The factory runs 24 hours a day with three different teams. What is each work period called?
questions.explanation: A “shift” is the block of hours one team works before the next one starts.

questions.prompt: It is against company _____ to share passwords with anyone.
questions.explanation: A “policy” is an official company rule.

questions.prompt: Antes de começar, quero garantir que estamos todos alinhados.
questions.answer: Before we start, I want to make sure we are all on the same page.|Before we start, I want to be sure we are all on the same page.
questions.explanation: “On the same page” means everyone understands the plan in the same way.

questions.prompt: Which word means an unfair opinion about a group of people?
questions.explanation: “Prejudice” is an unfair opinion; a financial loss is “a loss”.
